s: July 19, 2022 - In this report, we present a protocol to install dynamic, automated tunable lighting integrated into native home lighting systems as a potential sleep intervention for an older population at risk for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and related dementia. This protocol, TWLITE (Tunable White LIghtT for Elders), presents feasibility and acceptability outcomes in support for implementation in full-scale randomized clinical trials.
